recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-38028 unless future finalized UTG or terminology governance work changes the ownership, copyright, or publication model for biologicallyderived-productcodes.
issue_request: FHIR-38028 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction from OO asking to replace the ValueSet definition for BDP.productCodes from "Biologically Derived Product Codes." with wording explaining that the value set enumerates ISBT 128 Product Description Codes published by ICCBBA for characterization and classification of medical products of human origin.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was added to the build in commit 90413e8c33c8a3383f0781b6ff55a6f550f648ff. Inspecting that commit confirms it changed source/biologicallyderivedproduct/valueset-biologicallyderived-productcodes.xml from the old one-sentence definition to the requested ISBT 128 description.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has an active biologicallyderivedproduct=BiologicallyDerivedProduct entry, placing the inspected ValueSet source in current build scope. Later source harmonization changed formatting, version/status metadata, and copyright representation, but preserved the requested definition; the current text adds only a copyright symbol after "Product Description Codes". OO 2022-08-29 HCP minutes record that the BDP ValueSet description was missing and that FHIR-38028 was added to update it. UP-796 is a later unresolved UTG Proposal Draft for a code-system fragment and does not supersede this core ValueSet-definition decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The old "Biologically Derived Product Codes." definition is absent from the authoritative current ValueSet source, and the current description conveys the requested ISBT 128 wording.

related_jiras.note: Later unresolved Proposal Draft for an external terminology code-system fragment based on biologicallyderived-productcodes; not a finalized source edit for this ValueSet definition.
Mentioned in the same OO minutes as a separate technical correction for a different BDP property-type ValueSet name; not needed to decide FHIR-38028.
